blocks.x: From Las Vegas to Windsor, Ontario, Caesars Entertainment hotels, casinos, and experiences have won over guests with their premier service, glamorous suites, and gracious staff. Whether you’re looking for a classic Vegas stay in the sparkling Caesars Palace or a one-of-a-kind vacation to top destinations like New Orleans, Atlantic City, or even Lake Tahoe, Caesars delivers. There’s a location for every type of trip and at every price point—and with the promo codes and deals below, you’re guaranteed to find ways to save big when you check in. From weekend desert getaways to bachelorette parties and other group trips, you’ll be able to stick to any budget thanks to the Caesars Rewards promo codes below. Read on for everything you need for an unforgettable trip.
Save up to 15% off with these Caesars Rewards promo codes

Looking to maximize your Vegas wins? There are a ton of Caesars Rewards codes to choose from. With the Semi-Annual Sale, you can save up to 10% off your booking in select rooms with the Caesars Rewards promo code BAR. Book your stay by November 2, 2026, to score this limited-time deal. For those looking to test their luck on the Strip, or just get a little staycation in, use a 15% discount at any Caesars property in Las Vegas with promo code LOCAL. This can be used by Nevada residents for hotel bookings, spa appointments, cabana and daybed rentals, weddings, and popular attractions. Zipline from a 12-story tower and soar 1,121 feet from Las Vegas Boulevard or watch jaw-dropping tricks performed by Chris Angel.
Stay longer, save up to 20% more with this Caesars Rewards coupon

Get rewarded for extending your vacation with this sweet deal. Save up to 20% off your next Vegas getaway when you book three or more nights. This deal is valid on select room types and select properties only. You just need to apply the Caesars Rewards promo code STAYLVN at checkout and book your stay by October 31, 2027—easy as that.
Join Caesars Rewards Platinum & Diamond perks for up to 15% off

For Caesars Rewards members, ascending in membership tiers means more perks are unlocked. Caesars Rewards Platinum members can enjoy 15% off at casino gift shops while Diamond members get 15% off the best available rates on rooms and suites. Additionally, active-duty military members and veterans can take advantage of the Caesars Rewards military discount for 10% off hotel stays year-round. Plus, Salute cardholders receive an automatic upgrade to Caesars Rewards Platinum status.

While Las Vegas comes to mind for the famed Caesars Palace Hotel as well as its sister properties The Linq, the Nobu Hotel, and the Paris Hotel, the brand operates more than 50 properties across North America. Users who download the Caesars Rewards app gain access to exclusive user offers, reward tracking, and an express checkout option that’s quick and easy.
Save more at Caesars with advance purchase

Book 30+ days in advance to save even more on your next trip. Travelers who plan far in advance can use the Caesars Rewards promo code LVAPS to get up to 20% off their regular hotel rate. Be sure to book by December 18, 2026, for stays through March 2027 to cash in on your rewards. Keep in mind that a two-night minimum stay is required for this promotion and blackout dates do apply. One such hotel that is included in the promotion is Nobu Hotel Las Vegas, an exclusive-feeling boutique on Center Strip.
Save 10% on your stay with Caesars Best Rate Guarantee

The Caesars team doesn’t expect you to just book the first price you see. If you find a lower rate for a Caesars Hotel on a third-party website, the hotel team will price match so you get the best deal. Plus, they’ll add an extra 10% off so you know you’re getting the lowest rate at any of its standout hotels across the world.
What to do if your Caesars Rewards promo code is not working

If your Caesars Rewards promo code doesn’t seem to be working, don’t panic. There are a couple of things you can do to ensure that everything is in order. First, double-check your promo code and make sure that you’re typing it in correctly. Beware of things like incorrect capitalization, spacing, and letters that look like numbers. If all seems to be right, the next thing you can do is check the promo code’s fine print. Make sure that the property you’re applying it to isn’t excluded from the deal, that the expiration date hasn’t passed, and that you’ve met the minimum spend requirement if there is one. From there, you can refresh your browser, switch to a different device, or clear your cookies and cache to ensure that you don’t have any hardware or software issues. If you’re still having trouble, consider reaching out to Caesars Rewards customer support team for more help.
